brief.why: Later VR test: the picture and the car's shadow must stay right while the car drives AND turns, because turning swings the camera.
brief.start: Car parked and standing still, normal chase view behind it, open road ahead with room to turn right. Any time of day.
move: Hold W: drive straight about 3 seconds, steady speed, no boost.
Still holding W, one gentle right turn, about a quarter turn (hold D about 1 second).
Straighten up and drive about 2 more seconds.
Let go of W, hold S until the car stops.
brief.screen: The car and its shadow on the road the whole time, camera behind the car.
brief.avoid: Walls, other cars, boost, jumps, crashes; sitting still for long before starting (the game switches to a film-style camera with black bars).
brief.end: Stopped on the road facing along it; tap numpad minus there, then numpad star.

setup_notes: 2026-09-29: first recording (a free drive, night) cleared: the replay started in daylight at a different spot, so it did not match. Re-record to the brief.
